regression_gate.definition: Per echo and per (B1,B0,phase) case. STRICT failure = any magnitude drop below -1e-4 (normalized to unit-flip on-resonance slice integral). MATERIAL failure = candidate/baseline < 0.98. Phase changes > 10 deg are flagged, not gated, because intended timing changes legitimately move off-resonance phase.

disposition: v18->v181: no magnitude regression beyond 1e-4 in any echo/case (ratio range 1.00000-1.00000).

v191_v7->v1911: GATE FAILED (STRICT 172, MATERIAL 46); worst {'B1': 1.1, 'B0_Hz': -128.0, 'phase_deg': 90.0, 'echo': 8, 'delta': -0.006206979863268125, 'ratio': 0.969141169521035}. Not relabelled; see reviewer disposition in the report/handback. Model omits diffusion and relaxation (unless stated), so a time-compressed candidate's T2/diffusion benefit is not credited here.

pathway.scope: CONDITIONAL instantaneous-RF model: RF collapsed to signed-area rotation at the sample envelope centre, stationary box voxel, no finite slice profile, no diffusion during finite RF, no motion. (2pi)^2 included for encoded longitudinal states. Not a prediction of acquired signal and not a finite-RF result.

notes: Existing candidate JSONs whose sha does not match the current inputs are stale for that candidate.
y8 probes can alias the eight-cycle spoiler; use ny>=32 values. Convergence: compare ny 16/32/64.
RF latency 3 us and gradient lag 60 us are unmeasured assumptions and used only for sensitivity.
The historical +95 us shift is not hard-coded; the first-echo peak depends on grid, B1, B0 distribution.

limitations: Source-model PPL interpretation; no vendor compiler, no console timing, no measured RF/gradient delays.

EventBloch: finite RF with exact sample rotations, slice (z) and phase-voxel (y, ss-MGOT only) grids; no molecular diffusion, no read-axis spatial coordinate (read relocation in v1.81 is invisible to it), relaxation off in the gated grid.
RF calibration inferred from stock pulse and rfcal (linear model); achieved flips are scanner-verify.
b tensors are single selected coherence paths; low-angle FSE signal is a sum over pathways (see section 3).
Pathway model is instantaneous-RF, conditional on D=0.002 mm^2/s, T1 1.3 s, T2 32 ms.
Logical axes only; oblique physical axes not modelled.
Phase-voxel width assumes FOV 35 mm / no_views.
